name: patient_has_finding_of_dyspnea_on_exertion_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has exertional dyspnea (dyspnea on exertion).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of exertional dyspnea (dyspnea on exertion).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of exertional dyspnea (dyspnea on exertion).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has exertional dyspnea (dyspnea on exertion).
